articles.title: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
articles.description: OpenAI says its internal AI models have cracked three major open questions in math, computer science, and physics. articles.title: Does an Intermediate Price Facilitate Algorithmic Collusion?
articles.description: Extensive simulation studies of reinforcement learning algorithms in pricing environments suggest that it may be possible for them to learn to collude when including a memory of one period. Theoretical analyses of this phenomenon have focused on the setting with two prices, while the simulations have been carried out with up to fifteen prices. Here, we address this gap by analyzing the probability of observing collusion by Decentralized Q-learning in a pricing duopoly with three possible prices...
